thread:
lila: Quick follow-up from customer UX session  recurring confusion: the audit-log row shows a tiny lock + 'Encrypted' text but customers want to see WHICH key & when it was rotated. They ask for an easy way to get details without leaving the page. cc @dina @sam

dina: Iwe can add a lightweight "Encryption details" affordance (chevron or questionmark) that opens a popover/modal with: key type (Redwood vs Customer KMS), key id/alias if available, algorithm, and last rotation date. Keep it read-only.

sam: +1. Important: when key metadata is missing we currently render 'KMS' which is misleading. Change default to 'Unknown key' and provide a tooltip: "Key metadata unavailable. Contact support or check your KMS."

marcus: From product POV, show 'Rotation age' prominently and flag keys older than 90 days with a warn pill: 'Rotation due' so customers can spot risk. Not prescriptive, just indicator.

a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: popover must trap focus and allow Escape to close. Provide aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. For summary rows, screen readers need more context than just "Encrypted"; use aria-label like "Encrypted: Customer-managed key (alias: foo) rotated 2025-02-11". If alias missing, say "Encrypted: Customer-managed key, metadata unavailable".

infra: Implementation note: audit API returns encryption: {type, key_alias?, key_id?, alg?, rotated_at?} but rotated_at often null for older keys. We can surface available fields; for missing rotated_at show "Unknown rotation date". Also suggest a backend flag 'encryption_status' to convey stale keys for UI. INFRA will expose a boolean rotated_recently.

dina: Copy drafts for modal: header: "Encryption details". Body lines: "Key management: Redwood-managed" or "Customer-managed key (KMS)"; "Key alias: <alias or Unknown>"; "Algorithm: AES-256-GCM" (or Unknown); "Last rotation: <date or Unknown>"; CTA: small link "View key in KMS" when alias present. Add a short help blurb: "If metadata is missing, the key may have been created outside the ingestion pipeline."

sam: Also add a CSV export column 'encryption_details' containing key_alias|alg|rotated_at so compliance teams can ingest; infra flagged that payload size ok. We'll add compatibility header notes.

marcus: UX micro-nit: the row-level chevron should be keyboard accessible (tab focus), and should expose an accessible name like "Open encryption details for event 12345". Also add a subtle visual affordance when hovering the row to show details exist.

a11y-bot: For the row label, prefer using visible text + sr-only extra context rather than relying on title attribute. Ensure color contrast of the warn pill meets 4.5:1 for small text. Add role=status to the warn pill so screen readers get notified when row state changes after background rotation check.

dina: I'll update the mock: small chevron button, modal layout, copy, and include sr-only example strings. Plan: PR will include screenshot diffs and axe checks. ETA 72 hrs.

sam: I'll coordinate infra to add rotated_recently boolean and the additional CSV field. Filing ticket PRODUCT-8577 and linking to INFRA-1402.

lila: One more ask from the compliance team: add a quick filter "Rotation status: Any / Up to date / Rotation due / Unknown" in the audit UI so they can triage. Low-lift?

infra: Filter is easy if backend exposes rotation_state enum. We'll add rotation_state: up_to_date | due | unknown. INFRA-1402 updated.

marcus: Outcome: add Encryption details modal, change ambiguous 'KMS' -> 'Unknown key' when metadata missing, expose rotation info + warn pill, add CSV encryption_details, keyboard + a11y improvements, and backend fields for rotation state. Sam + Infra to link tickets, Dina to PR.

lila: Thanks all  closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
